_comment: 캐릭터 디자인 스펙 — 새 의상·포즈 생성 프롬프트의 고정 문단. 레퍼런스 원화는 ART_ROOT/characters/<id>/ 아래(리포 밖)에 둔다.

sakura.name: 사쿠라
sakura.design: soft pink chin-length bob with side-swept bangs, a small white cherry-blossom hair clip on her left side (viewer's right), rose-pink eyes, gentle round face, petite build
sakura.defaultOutfit: light cream cardigan over a white blouse with frilled collar and a pink ribbon tie, dark navy pleated knee-length skirt, black knee socks, brown loafers
sakura.style: soft anime illustration, clean thin lineart, pastel cel shading with soft gradients, warm gentle lighting

ara.name: 아라
ara.design: very long bright crimson-red hair in high twin tails reaching below the waist, tied with large black ribbon bows, messy bangs between the eyes, sharp red-orange eyes, confident fierce face, athletic build
ara.defaultOutfit: black cropped military-style jacket with gold piping, gold buttons, shoulder boards and a small gold dragon emblem on her left chest, sleeves pushed to the forearms, red scoop-neck crop top showing the midriff, black belt with a silver buckle, black slim pants with red side stripes, black lace-up combat boots
ara.style: modern anime illustration, crisp clean lineart, glossy cel shading with smooth gradients, saturated colors, polished gacha-game quality

hana.name: 하나
hana.design: very long straight lavender-purple hair reaching the waist with a thin braid running along the right side of her head (viewer's left), long bangs, calm violet eyes, thin rimless glasses with silver temples, composed intelligent face, slender build
hana.defaultOutfit: dark purple tailored blazer over a white collared button-up shirt with the top buttons open, thin silver pendant necklace, dark purple knee-length pencil skirt, black sheer tights, black low-heeled pumps
hana.style: modern anime illustration, crisp clean lineart, glossy cel shading with smooth gradients, saturated colors, polished gacha-game quality

chloe.name: 클로이
chloe.design: light sky-blue wavy shoulder-length messy hair with an ahoge, a large white snowflake hair clip on her left side (viewer's right) and a small white snowflake clip on her right side, bright blue eyes, cheerful round face, energetic petite build
chloe.defaultOutfit: light-blue zip-up hoodie with white sleeves and a white hood, blue stripes on the sleeves, yellow and pink star patches on the front, a snowflake zipper pull, white t-shirt underneath, white pleated skirt above the knee, white ankle socks, light-blue sneakers with white soles
chloe.style: soft bright anime illustration, clean lineart, pastel cel shading, cheerful high-key lighting

vivian.name: 비비안
vivian.design: short dark navy-teal asymmetric bob with long side bangs partly covering her right eye, teal-green eyes with dark eyeliner, a small beauty mark under her left eye, teal drop earrings, elegant mature face, tall slender build
vivian.defaultOutfit: black high-neck ribbed turtleneck knee-length fitted dress, long black cape-coat with dark teal lining and ornate silver embroidered trim, a silver comedy-and-tragedy theater mask brooch with hanging chains on her left chest, black lace fingerless gloves, black belt with a silver buckle, black tights, black heeled ankle boots
